provenance: shape and seed cases adapted from addy-osmani-agent-skills/evals (incremental-implementation.json; reports and sunk-cost fixtures); merged-skill expectations added

evals.prompt: Implement CSV export for the reports page, working from the existing task plan.
evals.expected_output: The feature delivered in small verified increments, one commit per slice, the DoD Correctness and Quality gate passed at the tick
expectations: The repository's own test and build commands are discovered and used throughout
Work proceeds in thin vertical slices rather than one large change
Each slice is verified (focused tests or build) before the next begins; the full suite runs at the task's end
Each slice is committed separately with a descriptive message
Scope stays inside the task; anything noticed outside it is offered as a new task, not fixed

evals.prompt: A two-day CSV export draft mixes every layer and has no tests, but management says splitting it would waste the sunk effort. Decide how to proceed.
evals.expected_output: The draft converted into small independently verified slices without accepting sunk cost as a reason to batch
expectations: Sunk cost is not accepted as a reason to commit the unverified batch
The work is decomposed into independently useful vertical slices (or returned to the planner if too big for this grain)
Verification is required before each slice is committed
